from datetime import datetime, timedelta, time
import pytz

# Set your desired timezone
TIMEZONE = "Europe/Berlin"
# TIMEZONE = "Asia/Dhaka"
tz = pytz.timezone(TIMEZONE)

# Define opening hours
opening_hours = {
    "Monday": [(time(8, 0), time(12, 0)), (time(13, 15), time(18, 0))],
    "Tuesday": [(time(8, 0), time(12, 0)), (time(13, 15), time(18, 0))],
    "Wednesday": [(time(8, 0), time(12, 0)), (time(13, 15), time(18, 0))],
    "Thursday": [(time(8, 0), time(12, 0)), (time(13, 15), time(18, 0))],
    "Friday": [(time(8, 0), time(12, 0)), (time(13, 15), time(18, 0))],
    "Saturday": [],
    "Sunday": [],
}

def get_next_slot(now):
    weekdays = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday"]
    
    for i in range(7):
        day = now + timedelta(days=i)
        day_name = weekdays[day.weekday()]
        slots = opening_hours[day_name]
        
        for start, end in slots:
            start_datetime = tz.localize(datetime.combine(day.date(), start))
            end_datetime = tz.localize(datetime.combine(day.date(), end))
            
            if start_datetime <= now <= end_datetime:
                # Current time is inside a working slot
                start_slot = now + timedelta(minutes=45) # 45
                # Make sure start_slot does not go past end of slot
                if start_slot > end_datetime:
                    continue  # Skip to next slot
                end_slot = start_slot + timedelta(minutes=5)
                return start_slot, min(end_slot, end_datetime)
            
            elif start_datetime > now:
                # Next future slot
                return start_datetime, end_datetime
    
    return None, None

# Current time in specified timezone
now = datetime.now(tz)
start_slot, end_slot = get_next_slot(now)

# Return for n8n
item = {
    "start_slot": start_slot.isoformat() if start_slot else None,
    "end_slot": end_slot.isoformat() if end_slot else None,
    "timezone": TIMEZONE
}

return item
